groups_in_priority_order.name: unavailable_masks
groups_in_priority_order.rule: Not all 64 future points valid; at least one valid prefix point required.

groups_in_priority_order.name: stationary_hold
groups_in_priority_order.rule: abs(raw current vx)<=0.1 and all 64 canonical target speeds<=0.1 m/s.

groups_in_priority_order.name: moving_to_stop
groups_in_priority_order.rule: raw current vx>0.1 and all last 10 canonical target speeds<=0.1 m/s.

behavior_analysis.provenance: Analyze the final checkpoint of each of all six fits; required SHA externally bound to campaign stage reports. Live audit source and training source use the same frozen commit. No embedded checkpoint source-commit claim.
behavior_analysis.metrics: Selected ADE/FDE/speed MAE, all candidates, raw runtime-v8 gate counts, STOP selection indices 6-11 only for B; exact terminal zero and <=0.1 m/s separately; reacceleration only after first exact-zero future point, excluding anchor.
behavior_analysis.limitations: Target-derived groups are diagnostic only, never forward inputs or traffic-rule STOP intent. Zero-count groups supply no evidence; overlapping windows are not independent events. Twelve render indices were fixed before any of these six fits.
behavior_analysis.scope: Six behavior passes are separate from eighteen normal stages; normal completion alone does not mean behavior completion.

decision.comment: HH_260906 - Freeze six DRIVE versus six DRIVE plus six STOP candidate development fits before actual training, preserving all legacy limitations and admission gates.
decision.purpose: Test whether an explicit physically decoded STOP family improves existing open-loop validation, not whether a safe traffic-aware stop policy has been learned.
decision.architecture: A has six DRIVE candidates and 954590 parameters. B preserves the original six DRIVE outputs and adds six STOP outputs for twelve candidates and 1056362 parameters. Existing shared and DRIVE initialization is bit-exact for the same seed; extra heads increase parameter capacity, so the comparison is not capacity-matched.
decision.objective: Both use the original best-of-K composite regression and 0.1 hard-oracle cross entropy, with the original six-key serialized loss config. No candidate-regret auxiliary is enabled.
decision.stop_limitations: STOP trajectories use the unchanged frozen primitive. At zero current speed the duration/curvature gradients can be zero and tied STOP candidates do not demonstrate traffic-intent learning. Decoder speed clamping does not waive the raw 30 kph input gate.
decision.budget: Six fresh whole-model fits, 1540 optimizer steps and 6155 training sample exposures each, batch 4. Final checkpoint only; no resume, best-epoch selection, repeat-until-pass or historical baseline substitution.
decision.candidate_screen: Selected ADE and FDE must improve in all three paired seeds; selected geometry pass count must not fall and selected speed MAE must not exceed 1.05 times baseline in any pair.
decision.known_data_limits: Unchanged legacy v3 train1147/val337 includes warmup anchors and infeasible deceleration labels. All denied new captures, including the four completed substep trials, remain excluded. Previous exploratory findings informed this declared research comparison.
decision.test_policy: Whole-corpus integrity checks may read test JSON/JPEG bytes. Test data is not used in training loss, neural-network inference, reported performance, diagnostics or model selection.
decision.promotion: No automatic model promotion, secure runtime export allowlist changes, vehicle actuation or data-admission/gate weakening. New STOPMIX model remains research-only and rejected by the existing secure runtime bundle boundary.
decision.finish_policy: Reserve every remaining stage timeout, six 180-second behavior slots and 300-second cleanup before 10:00 KST. Use only the assigned physical GPU0 and existing personal py312 venv; no installations, GPU1 queries, foreign process termination, reboot or real vehicle operation.
